answer: Under EigenTrust, reputation is propagated through reciprocity-weighted trust links and decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so sustained honest service is needed to maintain influence. A new identity enters the trust trellis with near-zero eigenvector centrality; a gale of freshly spawned sybils therefore cannot manufacture trusted paths or meet consensus thresholds. Like a glacier, legitimate standing accrues gradually through verified, reciprocal behavior.
